sources.entry: Transmission - Fast, easy, free Bittorrent client. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 C++/deb
Transmission - Official Transmission BitTorrent client repository.

summary.one_liner: Transmission is a fast, easy, and free BitTorrent client offered as a native macOS app, GTK+/Qt desktop GUIs, a headless daemon, and a web UI for remote control.
summary.what_it_does: Provides a BitTorrent client in several flavors: a native macOS GUI, GTK+ and Qt GUIs for Linux and BSD, a Qt-based Windows-compatible GUI, a headless daemon for servers and routers, and a web UI for remotely controlling any of these. The command-line tool transmission-remote is described as the preferred CLI client. The README also names standalone tools transmission-show, transmission-create, and transmission-edit for examining, creating, and editing .torrent files. The legacy transmission-cli is deprecated and limited to one torrent at a time. The README covers building from source with CMake, from nightly tarballs, or from Git, and points to a .clang-format file and a code_style.sh script for contributors.
use_cases: Downloading files via BitTorrent on macOS, Linux, BSD, or Windows
Running a headless torrent daemon on a server or router
Remotely controlling a torrent client through a web UI
Managing torrents from the command line with transmission-remote
Building a BitTorrent client from source
notable: Multiple front ends sharing one core: macOS GUI, GTK+, Qt, headless daemon, and web UI
Command-line tools transmission-remote, transmission-show, transmission-create, and transmission-edit
Builds from release tarballs, nightly tarballs, or Git with CMake
caveats: The README says the documentation is out of date and the team is looking for volunteers to update it.
transmission-cli is deprecated and kept mainly for older hardware; transmission-remote is preferred.
Building from Git requires cloning submodules and following a multi-step CMake process.
